items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: He had a rhythm section up there and I used to go up there on weekends, because he liked me -- Eddie Curran, he liked me. I played up there

ctx.x: At Christy's, yeah. He had a rhythm section up there and I used to go up there on weekends, because he liked me -- Eddie Curran, he liked me. I played up there... Oh, I forget what the hell is the name of this joint. It's right on Columbus and Mass...
